test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

If you are going downhill, you can go much fast.
solution:
The correct answer is **'much fast', i.e. the error lies in this part of the sentence.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the incorrect usage of adjective.
 
• The positive adjective i.e. 'fast' needs to be replaced with its comparative degree i.e.** 'faster'.**
 
• **Comparative degree adjective: **A comparative adjective is an adjective used to compare two people or things. We use comparative adjectives to say that one person or thing demonstrates a high degree of quality or is a better example of a quality than the other.
 
• Example:
 
 
• He is **taller **than his friend.
 
 
 
• If we look at the sentence, the sentence if giving a sense of comparison in driving from an original path that the person is following and the path suggested. It is being said in the sentence that if the driver follows the suggested path s/he can go faster in the suggested than the original path.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **option 3.**

 

**Correct answer: **__If you are going downhill you can go __**much faster**__**.**
